title: LEGO Set Completeness and Missing Parts
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), vinyl plays (`vinyl:play`), LEGO sets (`lego:set`), trading-card prices (`tradingcard:price`).
app: Collection catalogues and price APIs — Discogs (vinyl), BrickLink (LEGO), trading-card and coin/stamp price feeds, and personal inventory databases with NFC-tagged scans — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lego:set
| stats latest(owned_parts) as owned, latest(total_parts) as total by set
| eval complete_pct=round(100*owned/total,1), missing=total-owned
| where missing>0
| sort - missing
description: Tracks how complete each LEGO set is and how many parts are missing, guiding your BrickLink replacement orders.
value: A completeness view turns a bin of mixed bricks into a clear list of exactly which parts to reorder to finish a set.
implementation: Ingest owned-versus-total part counts into `index=personal`; surface sets with missing parts.
visualization: Table of LEGO sets by completeness and missing-part count.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how complete each LEGO set is and which pieces are missing, so you know what to order to finish it.
